en: Black‑and‑white view of a busy town square with market stalls and many people in traditional European clothing. The focal point is a large Renaissance‑style town hall with a steep tiled roof, gables, small towers with spires and a central clock. In the foreground, groups of women wearing regional folk costumes gather near a fountain; horse‑drawn carts and early carriages are visible at the right.
